Winter Wonderland in Central​
Step into Statue Square Garden, where a wondrous Christmas Town anchors Central’s holiday celebrations. Surrounded by a towering Christmas tree, sparkling decorations and a light show projected across iconic buildings, discover a classic Christmas experience in the heart of the city.
